free_tier.stated: Free Tier for Serverless: up to 1,000,000 tokens for models billed by tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription for models billed by audio minutes; billed per million tokens from token 1,000,001
free_tier.notes: the FAQ and the pricing page state the allowance as a total; whether it renews monthly or is granted once is not stated on either page

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.scaleway.ai/v1; Batches API available
chaining: Scaleway-hosted open models; the Batches API has no rate limit and a 50 per cent discount, which matters once the free tokens are gone

limits.value: 1,000,000 free tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription in the Free Tier, applied to the most expensive tokens first

Per organization, serverless: tokens per minute 200k per model with a payment method validated, rising with identity validation to 400k (gemma-3-27b-it, llama-3.3-70b-instruct), 1 000k (glm-5.2, gpt-oss-120b) or 2 000k (gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, qwen3.5-397b-a17b); requests per minute 300, rising to 600; concurrent requests 100; Batches API has no rate limit

identity_cost.detail: base rate limits apply if a valid payment method is registered and rise automatically after identity verification, quoted from the rate-limits page; whether the free tier can be used before a payment method is registered is not stated

reliability_note: per-model ceilings are published on the Organization quotas page: 200k tokens per minute and 300 requests per minute per model with a payment method, up to 400k to 2 000k tokens and 600 requests per minute after identity validation; 100 concurrent…
confidence_note: the allowance is quoted from the FAQ and pricing pages, the payment-method statement from the rate-limits page, and the per-model token, request and concurrency ceilings from the Organization quotas page; whether the free allowance renews is not stated on any page read
